welcome.title: Welcome to UniBoard
welcome.description: Let's connect your Canvas LMS and Ed Discussion accounts so we can start tracking your grades, deadlines, and course materials in one place.
welcome.subtitle: This takes about 2 minutes. You'll need access to Canvas and Ed.

tutorial.title: How to get your API tokens
tutorial.description: Follow these steps to generate tokens from Canvas and Ed. Don't worry, it's straightforward!

steps.1: Go to canvas.sydney.edu.au and log in
steps.3: Scroll down to Approved Integrations → click + New Access Token
steps.4: Enter purpose: UniBoard, leave expiry blank → click Generate Token
steps.5: Copy the token immediately — it won't be shown again!

steps.1: Go to edstem.org/eu/login and log in
steps.2: Select region → Australia (critical — default may be wrong)
steps.3: Log in with your student credentials
steps.5: Click Generate Token, name it UniBoard, and copy it

tokens.title: Connect your accounts
tokens.description: Paste the API tokens you generated. We'll validate them instantly.

security.title: Your tokens are safe.
security.description: They are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored securely. UniBoard only uses read-only access — we never post, submit, or modify anything on your behalf.

errors.canvas: Canvas token should be a numeric string (~70 characters). Check that you copied the full token.
errors.ed: Ed token should be a shorter alphanumeric string. Check that you copied the full token.

success.title: You're all set!
success.description: Canvas and Ed are connected. We're syncing your courses, grades, and deadlines right now.
